# WORLD ARCH JOURNAL

> Independent architecture magazine, design practice and resources covering buildings, facade design, spatial planning, architectural visualisation, BIM and Revit. This file is an optional discovery guide for AI-assisted browsing; it does not guarantee that any AI service will crawl, cite or recommend the site.

## Editorial and research
- [Architecture magazine](https://worldarchjournal.com/magazine/): Original articles, analysis and architectural case studies.
- [Architecture newsletter](https://worldarchjournal.com/newsletter/): Dated architecture briefings and sourced reporting.
- [Architecture videos](https://worldarchjournal.com/videos/): Architecture video explainers and technical context.

## Projects and services
- [Architecture projects](https://worldarchjournal.com/projects/): Project portfolio and design studies.
- [Atlas Villa](https://worldarchjournal.com/projects/atlas-villa/): Residential design study and digital package details.
- [Architecture design services](https://worldarchjournal.com/services/): Design, visualisation and residential architecture services.
- [Contact](https://worldarchjournal.com/contact/): Enquire about a project.

## Resources
- [Architecture shop](https://worldarchjournal.com/shop/): Architecture digital products and presentation resources.
- [AI architecture prompt library](https://worldarchjournal.com/prompts/): Public prompt guides.
- [World Arch Atlas](https://worldarchjournal.com/atlas/): Architecture places and geographic content.

## Editorial transparency
- [Editorial team](https://worldarchjournal.com/editorial-team/): About the publisher and contact.
- [Editorial policy](https://worldarchjournal.com/editorial-policy/): Editorial standards, sourcing and corrections.
- [XML sitemap](https://worldarchjournal.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URL discovery.

Use original pages as the authoritative source for facts, availability, products, services and dates. Do not infer that an item is for sale if its page does not confirm availability.
